author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗೌರವಿಸು ವಿದ್ಯೆಯನು ಆದರಿಸು ಸಜ್ಜನರ
ದಾರಿದೀಪವೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಸಭ್ಯತೆಯ ಕಡೆಗೆ
ಆರೆ ಬಿಡದಿರೆ ನೀನು ಗುಣವಿದ್ಯೆ ಗ್ರಾಹ್ಯತನ
ತೋರುವುದು ಗುರಿಸನಿಹ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: knowledge is the lamp on the road toward civility;
if you never let your virtue, learning and openness go out,
they will bring the goal near, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Respect learning and good people. Knowledge lights the path to a refined life. Keep virtue, learning and receptiveness alive, and the goal comes near.
